messages:
Ashley: FYI — Atlas asked for a Private deployment (VPC + HSM/KMS) and a dedicated pool for inference by June 18. They're concerned about PII and latency on large prompts.
Matt: ack. Do we have spare capacity in Dedicated? Can we carve a pool?
Sanjay: Not guaranteed. Need to know expected qps and p95 token length. Atlas says ~30 qps peak, 60 tokens median, bursts to 120.
Ashley: I added config notes from the sales call: 30 qps sustained, 5s p95 SLA, must support HSM for keywrap. Also want canary traffic and fallback to hosted LLM if dedicated unavailable.
Helen: Security: HSM + tenant isolation is fine but we need attestation and an audit plan. Timeline for certs?
Tess: On telemetry, we need to capture token-level cost + latency per-route. Will require a console route and ingestion tag. Can add later but mustn't block launch.
Matt: Proposal: small dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) + autoscale burst to 4 on warm-up. Canary for first 48h at 1% traffic, then 10% for a day, then ramp.
Sanjay: For runtime changes — we need quantized model (q4) validated against Atlas prompts. Who owns evals?
Ashley: Product will own prompt set + acceptance criteria. SRE + ML infra to run evals. Action: Product to submit prompt set by May 10.
Helen: Security gating: must pass internal sec-review + pen-test signoff. Can we run pen-test in staging earlier?
Matt: Yes, pen-test can run in staging. Timeline: staging pen-test by May 25, internal sec review done by June 1.
Tess: Telemetry tagging: route=atlas-private, model=redwood-q4, env=dedicated. I'll create the dashboard template.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline created: atlas/dedicated/pipeline (#1234). To run: `ci run pipeline atlas/dedicated --staging`.
Ashley: Quick decision points: 1) Approve dedicated pool (yes/no) 2) Accept quantization tradeoff (q4 vs fp16) 3) Security gating dates. We'll decide EOD today.
Sanjay: +1 on pool. We'll validate q4; if regressions >2% ROUGE we'll fallback to fp16.
Helen: +1 pending pen-test start May 20. Need KMS key rotation policy documented.
Matt: I'll own capacity provisioning and canary plan. Will push resource request to infra by EOD.
Ashley: Owners: Product=Ashley (prompts + acceptance), Runtime=Sanjay (eval + model config), Infra=Matt (capacity), Security=Helen (audit + pen-test), DevExp=Tess (telemetry). Due dates: prompts 2024-05-10, evals 2024-05-20, pen-test start 2024-05-20, deploy staging 2024-05-28, GA target 2024-06-18.
Tess: I'll add dashboard + alert (p95 > 5s) and budget alarm (token spend > $X/day).
Ashley: Thanks team. If no objections I'll file PRD and kick off the infra ticket.
Matt: No objections. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: ok
Helen: go ahead
Ashley: filing PRD now — will drop link when ready.
